collection_policy: No numeric cap; finish the finite declared review pool without stopping after 50/55 accepted identities.

quality_review.review_scope: Second-pass admission screening of the 63 science-extra accepted candidates. All 63 records, README distribution excerpts, representative format/licence flags, canonical path counts and exceptions were screened; targeted full README/content/packaging evidence resolves application and generated-entry doubts. Previous primary representative reviews remain distinct. No third-party install, runtime, model, or API workflow executed.

corrections.count_basis: Skill infrastructure, not six production-certified leaf skills. The README explicitly offers six copyable fictional starter workflows in examples/skills; the internal ui-polish skill and documentation mirror are excluded.
corrections.reason: Replace an imprecise many-skills display with explicit infrastructure and starter-example typing.

corrections.count_basis: 24 generated cross-vendor SKILL.md discovery entries in defaults/.agents/skills: 11 role/operator entries and 13 supporting protocols/reference entries. They share sources with the Claude slash commands and are not 24 additional independent leaf workflows. All 24 fixed headers were inspected; README installer and generated frontmatter establish intended public distribution. No installation or execution.
corrections.reason: Public cross-vendor defaults are valid distribution, but supporting reference entries must be distinguished from primary workflows.

corrections.distribution_evidence: README presents a publicly downloadable skills-capable desktop application. At the pinned commit electron-builder.yml explicitly includes resources/**/* and unpacks resources/**; builtinSkills.ts installs bundled resource skills into the global skills catalog and enables them for agents; SkillService.ts manages skill installation and SDK discovery mirrors. This establishes public product distribution of runtime skills, separately from developer-maintenance instructions.
corrections.count_basis: 27 runtime resource entry points: 6 resources/skills entries, 14 code-cli adapters, and 7 cherry-assistant builtin entries. Exclude 13 .agents development-only entries. This is a mixed product bundle including imported/adapted skills and CLI adapters, not 27 newly authored independent workflows. Packaging and installation logic inspected statically; no app build or execution.
corrections.license_scope: Root community application and sampled code-mate instructions are AGPL-3.0. The bundled claude-automation-recommender carries its own Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE documenting Anthropic authorship and local modifications; resources/skills/skill-creator carries its own Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt. Preserve these directory terms rather than overriding them with root AGPL. Commercial exemptions, coding CLIs, model providers, and hosted services retain separate terms. Metadata index only; no third-party instruction text copied.
corrections.reason: Resolve README-only uncertainty using pinned package/runtime code; retain important per-directory Apache exceptions.
